attributes.title: Template row: Done claim has no artifact
attributes.body:
The `Template` concept (layer 03, Cards & Models) is marked **Done** with owner `lucas` (App 2 v1.1 note), but the 2026-08-26 check found no `sharedSpec`, no `whereImplemented`, and no Spec named Template under any alias. The crawl's own audit status is still **Missing**.

Three *domain* templates exist in the realm — `onboarding-template.gts`, `offer-letter-template.gts`, `contract-template.gts` — but no generic Template block anyone can adopt.

Quest Log needs Template (P1, template library is a core feature). Per the matrix-first gate this row is owned, so no parallel build: **coordinate with lucas** — either the row's state is corrected, or the generic block gets built with his App 2 templates as its first consumers. Until then Quest Log's stage 2 falls back to an app-local QuestTemplate, recorded as a gap (the ContentStatusField precedent).
